about: anidoodle's own review record for launchExample, the drawn worked example of the launch template. Written by fresh critics (agents), not a person's review. A film made from the template gets its own record, written for that film (references/workflows/review.md).
verdict: ship (critic r4, an agent): no open P0 or P1; 1 open optional P2

findings.note: Frames 120 to 140 (9:16): the answer card's byline words vanished under the thread's top while its dot stayed behind. The dot now goes with its words (inkCard), and a byline nearing the window's top fades out whole.
findings.by: fresh critic r1, an agent; r2 (an agent) found d1-1 still open on 9:16 (the zone fade withheld the words, not the dot); fixed again and confirmed by fresh critic r3, an agent

findings.note: The corner mark touched the chat window's bottom right corner (16:9 frames 0 and 345, 9:16 frames 0 and 270). It now sits clear of the window: beside it on 16:9 (the room creeps about that corner), under it on 9:16 with room for the hook's creep.
findings.by: fresh critic r1, an agent; confirmed fixed by fresh critics r2 and r3 (agents)

findings.note: The end card's install lines were each centred, so they started at different places. Every line now starts at the panel's left padding, as a terminal sets them.
findings.by: fresh critic r1, an agent; confirmed fixed by fresh critics r2 and r3 (agents)

findings.note: End card sits 8 to 20 px left of centre on both shapes, consistent across lines: likely the headline glyphs' side bearing. Optional polish; centring by ink bounds instead of advance width would fix it. Fixed (template round 3): the cause was the end card's settle, a 3 % lean about the dot at the name's right end, which carried every line left by 3 % of the dot's distance from the axis. The settle now zooms about the card's axis, and the name with its dot is centred by its ink (kinetic.inkSpan). Measured on the render: every line within 1.5 px of the centre on 16:9 and 9:16 (test endCardCentre).
